conclusion: Owner confirms English/German Space recognition using the built-in microphone and speakers in a slightly noisy room, live draft updates in both languages, draft correction before explicit Submit and Stop mic during a hold. Releasing Space stops listening and leaves the draft editable and unsent. Brief Space taps insert normal spaces without starting the microphone. The Whisper/Submit attempt clears the draft but produces no observed response; end-to-end delivery remains inconclusive. Follow-up on 2026-10-16 found the saved dialogue model gemma3 absent from reachable local Ollama; the authored initial Healer distance also exceeds Whisper range. The owner selected gemma4:e4b; saved settings were updated, its local availability check passed and the game restarted. Live listener position and a corrected-setup reply outcome remain unconfirmed. Selector/permission details, language-specific final text and remaining lifecycle/device/echo cases stay open. The owner screenshot confirms local acceptance with Whisper enabled and response NONE. Source inspection identifies an additional missing Ollama participation binding before reply generation; the owner-approved repair is implemented and its local-model diagnostic commits a reply. The recovered full gate passed 217 recorded stages and 5,629 unit tests; the repair is closed and human qualification remains partial. In the repaired live session, the owner reports two successful spoken dialogue turns followed by failure. The screenshot shows Whisper enabled, ACCEPTED submission, FAILED character response, interrupted reply speech and the previous reply still visible. Repeated dialogue is therefore unreliable; this is a new observation, not a reversal of successful recognition or of the closed one-turn repair evidence. The separately approved response repair now constrains Ollama speech/mode pairing and completes valid silent turns. Eight distinct fictional controlled and local-model requests and recovered full quality passed. Human repeated dialogue and echo remain unqualified; the reported failure is retained. After restart, the owner initially reports intermittent missing responses, then clarifies that ordinary questions still receive answers while action requests such as herb-patch examination produce neither visible action nor reply. This is an action-handling gap, not evidence of a general post-repair dialogue or playback outage. Source tracing confirms silent examination is eligible but blocked by speech-dependent occurrence, and the logical examination flow never commands movement. The exact model response in the human submission remains unknown. Existing completion checks permitted valid silence and did not qualify embodied action execution. The bounded action repair proposal awaits its distinct runtime grant; physical case totals remain unchanged.

submit_observation_triage.source_confirmed_blocker: Before repair: TryApplyParticipationBindings binds only OpenAI; Ollama leaves the participation source unbound. TakeModel consequently uses UnavailableParticipationModel, which throws. The coordinator starts a reply only on a successful completed participation round. Thus an ordinary Ollama reply cannot proceed through this unbound path, regardless of model availability. No exception from the exact owner submission was captured.
